name: calc_retirement
description:
Retirement savings projection: compounds the balance annually and adds the contribution at the end of each year. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {final_balance, total_contributed, investment_growth}.
Inputs (* required): current_savings* (amount), annual_contribution* (amount per year), return_rate* (annual percent), years* (integer).
For a lump sum alone use calc_compound_interest or calc_future_value.
Example: {"current_savings": 50000, "annual_contribution": 12000, "return_rate": 6, "years": 25}

annual_contribution.description: Amount added at each year end
